steps.title: Cru on Claude Code
steps.body: An experiment: Cru can answer through your own Claude Code, on your subscription, instead of the Claude API. Same tools, same rules, same notebook. Switch it in Settings, where the two are compared on speed and cost as you use them.

steps.title: Cru closes when you go quiet
steps.body: After a minute of silence the voice screen closes itself, on the phone, the web and the PC; "Hey Cru" opens it again. Change the time in Settings.
